name: Holiday Honey-Glazed Spiral Cut Ham (Tender Lean Slices)
whyItWorks: Spiral-cut ham is pre-cooked, tender, and provides pure lean animal protein. The caramelized brown sugar glaze is seed-free and easy to digest.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Carve lean slices from the bone, trimming any visible exterior ribbon of fat. Enjoy warm with soft white dinner rolls.
watchOuts: Ham has cured sodium; drink plenty of water
